slides.prompt: Design a finished 16:9 keynote slide image in sketch/etching style. Use the style master reference exactly — cream paper #F5F0EB background, sepia ink #2D1B11 sketch lines, amber #D97706 accents, serif typography. MODE A — CENTERPIECE SKETCH. A horizontal timeline drawn in fine sepia ink across the cream paper, left to right: 2024 → 2025 → 2026. Three light sources sketched along the timeline — 2024 is a tiny candle-flame in faded ink, 2025 is a larger lamp glow, 2026 is a radiating sun-like orb in warm amber wash with etched radial lines. Below the timeline, three code fragments evolve from one-line completion to a full project structure. The timeline line transitions from thin faded ink to bold sepia. KICKER THREE YEARS in small all-caps above a thin amber horizontal line. Title in large serif sepia ink below. No logos, watermarks. No photography. No vector graphics. No blue.
